summary: Gate 10 frontend review of PR #77 (NFR-REL-001 Auto-Save Crash Durability) — APPROVED. All 6 findings from Gates 8 and 9 verified as resolved: B1 (useAutoSave reads actual scene state from sceneStore), B2 (package.json reverted to main baseline with only idb/fake-indexeddb/globals added), B3 (idb ^8.0.0 added to production dependencies), M1 (ResumePrompt.test.tsx and useAutoSave.test.ts import real production modules), M2 (console.warn added to persistenceService.ts catch block), M3 (console.warn added to all 4 catch blocks in persistenceStore.ts). Architecture, idb usage, atomic transactions, crash detection, accessibility, data-testid attributes, and dependency graph all pass review. 6 low observations tracked for future improvement.

B1.verification: useAutoSave.ts imports useSceneStore and calls getState() inside interval callback. Reads actual bricks, cameraState, sceneMetadata with sensible fallbacks.

B2.verification: Package name legobuilder preserved. Core deps intact (immer, zustand ^4.5.0, vite ^5.4.0). Scripts preserved. Only additions: idb, fake-indexeddb, globals, @vitest/coverage-v8.

B3.verification: Commit 9ddac16 adds idb ^8.0.0 to dependencies section. dbSchema.ts import from 'idb' will now resolve correctly.

M1.verification: ResumePrompt.test.tsx imports real ResumePrompt component. useAutoSave.test.ts imports real useAutoSave hook with proper mocks. crashRecoveryService.test.ts and persistenceService.test.ts use contract stubs — acceptable for service-level IndexedDB tests.

M2.verification: console.warn('[persistenceService] Could not read existing meta:', err) added to catch block.

M3.verification: All 4 catch blocks now have console.warn with descriptive prefixes: markSessionClosed, checkForCrashRecovery, resumeSession, discardSession.

low_observations.title: No closeDB() for HMR cleanup alongside resetDBPromise()

Minor out-of-scope changes: @eslint/js and typescript-eslint removed, lint script patterns changed, three-mesh-bvh bumped ^0.7.0 to ^0.8.0, typescript range changed ^ to ~, vitest/coverage-v8 version ranges adjusted
